Kit flag on Malzahar E reads 'execute: threshold kill' but Riot's description is a spreading DoT with no threshold — flag misfire, so the missing-interactions 'execute-threshold' headline was not written into the page.

edits.before: - Malzahar Nether Grasp: matchup-defining — Point-and-click suppression — never step up solo while his passive shield is intact and R is up. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your E Abscond (shield-dash) like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Nether Grasp: 140/110/80s — never step up solo while his passive shield is intact and R is up; its long downtime is your green light. - His Q silence cycles every 6s and eats your E if pre-cast — dash after it fires. - Your stolen ult goes to kill windows only.

edits.before: E-shield in, E2-chain, Q-W with whirls between, heal out — the full brawl string he answered with one rotation and regret.
edits.after: His R is a 700-range point-and-click suppress; stolen at 6 it locks an immobile mage who cannot dodge it. Take it on first contact.

edits.before: Chaining into a loaded CC with W down — Sylas without the heal is a mage who chose melee for the aesthetic.
edits.after: Your R steal is back every 80/55/30 seconds — spending it on a good window beats hoarding it through two lost fights.

notes: Kit derived flag misfire: Malzahar E is tagged 'execute' but Riot's text describes a spreading DoT with no kill threshold — I did not write the execute-threshold headline from _missing on that basis. Level chart agrees across both layers (Sylas x7) and with the packet; left alone. Malzahar passive is damage reduction + CC immunity (not a spell shield), but the page's 'pop the shield' shorthand is how players refer to it and stays accurate in effect.
